text:
Julie M: Heads-up — sales got a PHI customer asking for a per-endpoint throughput addon + regional SLA. They want Dedicated or Private only.
Ajay P: Which customer and what scale? any contract asks?
Julie M: Acme Health. They need 2x endpoint throughput, 95th latency <150ms, regional isolation (eu-west), and a SOC2/HIPAA addendum.
Samir: Sounds like 'priority lane' but per-endpoint. Product question: is this a new addon or variant of existing QoS? Billing question: slab vs metered?
Karen: From CS — they'll do a sizeable commit if we can guarantee no-throttle during maintenance windows. They explicitly want dedicated pool.
Noah: Note: Private/on-prem customers can't ship telemetry. That will change our observability and compliance path.
Julie M: Proposed approach:
- Offer a 'Throughput Booster' addon scoped to a route (per-endpoint) as a fixed-capacity slab + defined burst profile.
- Require Dedicated or Private for addon.
- Pricing: slab-based monthly fee + regional isolation uplift.
- Launch criteria: perf tests, billing hooks, SLA doc, legal template (BAA/SOC2), and pilot customers.
Ajay P: Can we reuse the existing quota UI + rate-limit hooks? Also need to think about router changes for per-endpoint routing decisions.
Samir: Engineering ballpark: ~4 weeks to wire routing + billing hooks if we can reuse quota UI. If we need new kernel-level optimizations for latency under load, add 2–3 weeks.
Karen: Sales asks for negotiation levers: trial credits, limited-time pricing, and a canary window. Keep those in the term sheet.
pricing-bot: :information_source: Historical note — adding a throughput addon in a prior pilot bumped commit conversions by ~22% (see 1747654321).
Noah: Security/compliance: PHI requires BAA and per-tenant audit logs retained for X years. That increases lead time; involve compliance early.
Julie M: Action items: @Ajay P write a short scope doc with API surface + UI mock by EOW; @Samir confirm eng estimate + list dependencies; @Karen gather customer ask doc (Acme + 1–2 other prospects) and desired SLA language; I'll draft a contract clause snippet.
Ajay P: On it — will include examples of API params for `throughput_slab` and `burst_window`.
Samir: 4 wks is my optimistic timeline, I'll call out the unknowns (routing, KV cache impact, autoscaling config).
Karen: I'll schedule a call with Acme for Wed and invite legal.
Julie M: If we can land scope and eng estimate by EOW, propose a limited pilot (Acme + 2 accounts) and a phased launch (EA -> GA).
Noah: +1. Also add a privacy/dataflow checklist for Private deployments.
Samir: Quick note — we should add a rollback/fallback policy so if Dedicated pool is saturated we route to compatible model variant (with customer opt-in).
Julie M: Good call. I'll add fallback policy to the scope doc.
Karen: Thanks everyone — I'll post the customer notes after the Wed call. :thumbsup:
pricing-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder: include billing test cases in the launch checklist (metering, invoice sample, prorations).
